mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, we are looking at 61 degrees with light drizzle over Verona Community Park. If you are outside later tonight, look for the space station to streak across the sky starting at 7:40 PM, appearing over the high school area in the northwest and traveling toward the northeast.

The city has announced that road maintenance through chip sealing will begin on September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review several development proposals on October 5, including site plans for Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival today and the Dane County Farmers Market on the square. You can also catch live music today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, don't miss the Bike the Barns fundraiser at Badger Prairie County Park.

In our weekly look at police activity, officers responded to a call on September 5 involving a series of vehicles found with cheese slices on their windshields, which they discovered was a viral social media prank.
While Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, they are scheduled to open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
